The '''Kashyyyk Royal City''' was a [[city]] located on the [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]] [[planet]] [[Kashyyyk]], [[homeworld]] of the [[Sentience|sentient]] [[Wookiee]] [[species]].<ref name="BMF 43" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], the Kashyyyk Royal City was introduced in the [[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon 43|forty-third]] issue of the [[De Agostini]] ''[[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon]]'',<ref name="BMF 43" /> which was published around [[October 28]], [[2015]].<ref name="BMFdate">{{BuildFalconDates|43}}</ref> The [[Kashyyyk Royal City/Legends|city]] originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it first appeared in [[Jake Forbes]]'s [[2008]] young readers book ''[[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: The Way of the Jedi]]''.<ref name="DecideDestiny">''[[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: The Way of the Jedi]]''</ref>
